source.title: Cerebral schistosomiasis: Case series from Qatar
source.source_type: case report; three-patient case series with narrative literature review

extraction_metadata.scope_note: Primary case-series findings were atomized at case and source level. Background claims and results from cited literature were not converted into primary-study atoms. Bibliographic entries were excluded from atomization and exported separately as a task queue.

atoms.canonical_statement: The report describes three unusual cases of schistosomiasis in Qatar that presented as intracerebral tumor-like lesions.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Three unusual presentations of schistosomiasis in Qatar are described herein.

atoms.canonical_statement: The case series comprised three young male patients who presented with seizures and tumor-like lesions on brain imaging.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The three patients were young males who presented with seizures and tumor-like lesions on brain imaging.

population.label: Three young male patients from the Philippines with biopsy-confirmed cerebral schistosomiasis treated in Qatar

atoms.canonical_statement: Across the three reported patients, tissue biopsy confirmed cerebral schistosomiasis by demonstrating Schistosoma eggs within granulomatous inflammation.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The diagnosis was confirmed by biopsy, which showed necrotizing granulomas containing Schistosoma eggs.

population.label: Three young male patients from the Philippines with biopsy-confirmed cerebral schistosomiasis treated in Qatar

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Approved by the Institutional Review Board (IRB) and Medical Research Centre of Hamad Medical Corporation.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: No financial support to declare.

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 1 was a 29-year-old Filipino man living in Qatar who presented in December 2016 with generalized tonic-clonic seizures after a prior trip to the Philippines that included lake swimming.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: In December 2016, a 29-year-old Filipino man presented to the emergency department with generalized tonic-clonic seizures.

population.label: Case 1: 29-year-old Filipino man presenting with generalized tonic-clonic seizures

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 1 had no focal neurological deficit; CSF showed 11 × 10^6 white cells/L with normal protein and glucose, and stool examination did not detect parasitic eggs.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: His cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) was clear with a white blood cell count of 11 × 10⁶ cells/l; protein and glucose were normal. No parasitic eggs were detected in the stool.

population.label: Case 1: 29-year-old Filipino man presenting with generalized tonic-clonic seizures

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 1 MRI showed left anterior temporal and frontal gyrus T2/FLAIR hyperintensity with nodular and linear post-contrast enhancement.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Cerebral magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) revealed left anterior temporal lobe and frontal gyrus areas of high-signal intensity on T2/FLAIR, with a nodular and linear pattern of enhancement in the post-contrast study.

population.label: Case 1: 29-year-old Filipino man presenting with generalized tonic-clonic seizures

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 1 temporal-lesion biopsy showed necrotizing granulomas containing Schistosoma eggs, some calcified, and S. mansoni serology was positive.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Histopathological examination showed brain parenchyma infiltrated by necrotizing granulomas harboring Schistosoma eggs.

population.label: Case 1: 29-year-old Filipino man presenting with generalized tonic-clonic seizures

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 1 received praziquantel 60 mg/kg per day for 1 day and prednisolone 30 mg daily for 1 week followed by a 5 mg weekly taper.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The patient received praziquantel (60 mg/kg per day) for 1 day and prednisolone 30 mg daily for 1 week, which was tapered down by 5 mg weekly.

population.label: Case 1: 29-year-old Filipino man presenting with generalized tonic-clonic seizures

exposures.details: Dose tapered down by 5 mg weekly.

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 1 was discharged after 26 days and had complete symptom resolution at 3-month follow-up.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: He was discharged after 26 days and showed complete resolution of symptoms at the 3-month follow-up.

population.label: Case 1: 29-year-old Filipino man presenting with generalized tonic-clonic seizures

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 2 was a previously healthy 26-year-old Filipino man who presented in May 2018 after two tonic-clonic seizures and reported 4 months of intermittent headache.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A previously healthy 26-year-old Filipino male presented to the emergency department in May 2018 due to two episodes of tonic-clonic seizures.

population.label: Case 2: previously healthy 26-year-old Filipino man presenting with two tonic-clonic seizures and intermittent headache

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 2 had positive S. mansoni serology and no parasitic eggs detected in stool.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Serology for schistosomiasis was positive for S. mansoni. No parasitic eggs were detected in the stool.

population.label: Case 2: previously healthy 26-year-old Filipino man presenting with two tonic-clonic seizures and intermittent headache

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 2 MRI showed right parietal and left frontal and parieto-occipital subcortical mass lesions with T2/FLAIR hyperintensity, T1 hypointensity, irregular nodular post-contrast signals, edema, and mass effect on the left lateral ventricle.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: MRI of the brain showed right parietal and left frontal and parieto-occipital subcortical mass lesions with hyperintensity on T2/FLAIR and hypointensity on T1.

population.label: Case 2: previously healthy 26-year-old Filipino man presenting with two tonic-clonic seizures and intermittent headache

atoms.canonical_statement: In Case 2, frozen section was reported as gliosis, while final histopathology showed Schistosoma eggs surrounded by granulomatous inflammation with a perivascular lymphocytic cuff.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A biopsy was performed and a frozen section reported as gliosis. Histopathology showed brain parenchyma with Schistosoma eggs surrounded by granulomatous inflammation.

population.label: Case 2: previously healthy 26-year-old Filipino man presenting with two tonic-clonic seizures and intermittent headache

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 2 received praziquantel 60 mg/kg per day and prednisolone 50 mg per day for 2 weeks.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The patient was treated with praziquantel (60 mg/kg per day) and prednisolone (50 mg per day) for 2 weeks.

population.label: Case 2: previously healthy 26-year-old Filipino man presenting with two tonic-clonic seizures and intermittent headache

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 2 was discharged after 14 days in good condition and responded to praziquantel, but recurrent neurological symptoms required repeated corticosteroid courses.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The patient had an excellent response to praziquantel therapy, but required repeated courses of corticosteroid therapy to suppress recrudescent neurological symptoms.

population.label: Case 2: previously healthy 26-year-old Filipino man presenting with two tonic-clonic seizures and intermittent headache

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 3 was a 25-year-old Filipino man who presented in September 2010 after two tonic-clonic seizures and was confused, agitated, and disoriented without focal neurological deficit; CSF was normal.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A 25-year-old Filipino male presented in September 2010 due to two episodes of tonic-clonic seizures.

population.label: Case 3: 25-year-old Filipino man presenting with two tonic-clonic seizures, confusion, agitation, and disorientation

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 3 MRI showed three abnormal T2/FLAIR signal areas in the right frontal, occipital, and parieto-occipital regions with cortical thickening and post-contrast enhancement; EEG showed right frontal epileptiform and ictal discharges spreading leftward.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: MRI of the brain showed three areas of abnormal signal intensity on T2/FLAIR involving the right cerebral hemisphere in the region of the frontal, occipital, and parieto-occipital lobes.

population.label: Case 3: 25-year-old Filipino man presenting with two tonic-clonic seizures, confusion, agitation, and disorientation

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 3 underwent frameless stereotactic biopsy of the right parietal lesions under neuronavigation.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Frameless stereotactic biopsy of the right parietal lobe lesions under neuronavigation was done.

population.label: Case 3: 25-year-old Filipino man presenting with two tonic-clonic seizures, confusion, agitation, and disorientation

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 3 histopathology showed Schistosoma eggs surrounded by exuberant granulomatous inflammation, confirming neuroschistosomiasis.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Histopathological examination revealed brain parenchyma with Schistosoma eggs surrounded by exuberant granulomatous inflammation.

population.label: Case 3: 25-year-old Filipino man presenting with two tonic-clonic seizures, confusion, agitation, and disorientation

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 3 received praziquantel 60 mg/kg per day, dexamethasone 12 mg per day, and phenytoin.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The patient was treated with praziquantel (60 mg/kg per day), dexamethasone (12 mg per day), and phenytoin.

population.label: Case 3: 25-year-old Filipino man presenting with two tonic-clonic seizures, confusion, agitation, and disorientation

atoms.canonical_statement: Case 3 was discharged after 14 days in good condition; at 4 months he reported complete symptom resolution and repeat brain MRI showed marked improvement.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Four months after receiving the treatment, the patient reported complete resolution of the symptoms and repeat MRI of the brain showed a dramatic improvement.

population.label: Case 3: 25-year-old Filipino man presenting with two tonic-clonic seizures, confusion, agitation, and disorientation

atoms.canonical_statement: Neuroschistosomiasis was not initially considered in the differential diagnosis of the three patients; MRI initially suggested tumor.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Neuroschistosomiasis was not initially considered in the differential diagnosis of our patients. A tumor was initially considered the likely diagnosis on the basis of MRI findings.

population.label: Three young male patients from the Philippines with biopsy-confirmed cerebral schistosomiasis treated in Qatar

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors argue that clinicians should suspect neuroschistosomiasis in patients with seizures and tumor-like brain lesions when they come from or have traveled to endemic areas.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The clinician should maintain a high level of suspicion when assessing patients presenting with seizures and tumor-like lesions on brain imaging, especially if the patient comes from an endemic area.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors state that a nodular MRI enhancement pattern is not pathognomonic but should raise suspicion for neuroschistosomiasis.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Although not pathognomonic, an MRI finding of a nodular pattern of enhancement should raise suspicion for neuroschistosomiasis.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors would not have been confident treating the cases with antischistosomal chemotherapy alone without tissue diagnosis because missing a neoplasm would have serious consequences and stool or serologic abnormalities could be incidental.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: It is unlikely that we would have felt confident in treating them with anti-schistosomal chemotherapy alone, in the absence of a tissue-based diagnosis.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors conclude that early appropriate treatment is important to limit central nervous system tissue damage and chronic neurological sequelae.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Early and appropriate treatment is of paramount importance to minimize CNS tissue damage and prevent chronic sequelae.
